# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Role:** mail carrier (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Nell-girl P24](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0024)</sub>  
  _previously: farmer (v2)_  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P8](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0008), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P20](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P55](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0055), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P70](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0070), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P39](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

Not considered a good-looking man, he is low in stature, heavy-set, and lacks hair. He has a circular countenance and bulging azure eyes, and is known to smoke a pipe.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

## Personality

Pettifer is a candid and admittedly impetuous man who harbors a strong resentment toward being pitied. Though generally known as pleasant, he is also exacting, critical, and difficult to satisfy.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P78](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0078), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), [v3 ch.Atonement” P39](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0039), [v3 ch.Atonement” P41](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0041)_

## History

A lifelong bachelor who had delayed marriage for too long, Mr. Pettifer originally lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), before relocating to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). Having routinely been flogged by his schoolmaster as a boy, he kept a pet parrot named [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), which had been given to him by his brother, a sailor. His relationship with his neighbor [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) got off to a tense start when he angrily confronted her over a cow escaping into his oat field; however, after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) mistakenly sold his Jersey cow and offered a trade, he took the mistake generously and invited her for tea. He later turned down Nell's request for a community donation, but he continued to engage in friendly local debates with her. During a severe hailstorm, lightning struck his home and killed [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), though he was comforted by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and eventually reconciled with his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), sharing the story of their marriage and quarrel over the parrot. Pettifer also encouraged Nell's literary pursuits, offering critiques on a manuscript she wrote and advising her to keep writing about what she knew after her initial rejections. He later visited [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) during a severe winter snowstorm to deliver her mail, which contained news of an inheritance.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), +34 more_

## Quotes

> "Apologies, young lady! Expressing regret will not fix what happened. You ought to walk over and view the destruction that creature caused among my oats . . . crushed them completely from the middle to the edges, young lady."
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> "He . . . he utters foolishness constantly. My brother, a seafaring man, gave him to me. A sailor's speech isn't always particularly refined, and birds like parrots copy things easily."
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)

> “Who? Mrs. Sowerby? Do not tell me that I resemble that ancient chatterbox,” Mr. Pettifer said in an annoyed manner. “I am not . . . not in the least. What is inside that box?”
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P27](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0027)

> "I do not, indeed, and I am extremely pleased with it, as well. You have my gratitude. The surface appears nice. My expectation is that it remains just as nice underneath."
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Listen to my suggestion, young lady, you need to assist me in consuming it. After I set the kettle to boil, a cup of tea will be enjoyed by both of us. Is that acceptable to you?"
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

### Henry

### [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-henry-carter--pettifer.md)

Pettifer employs [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) as a hired helper and worker. Following a severe storm that struck Pettifer's house, [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) checked on the damage and reported to others that Pettifer's pet parrot had been killed by lightning.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), +2 more_

- Commands — employed as a hired helper or worker  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--pettifer.md)

Pettifer and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are neighbors who frequently meet to converse, share tea, and debate local affairs like the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Their relationship started on tense terms over stray livestock, including an incident where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally sold Pettifer's cow, though Pettifer reacted generously and accepted her replacement offering. While he occasionally turns down her requests for community donations, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) still visits to offer comfort, such as when his pet parrot died in a severe storm.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), +23 more_

- Friend of — neighbors who share visits and conversations  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)</sub>

### [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/pettifer--robin-farrow.md)

Pettifer shares a friendly bond with [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), who admires him and assists him with hauling dulse. However, their connection experiences friction due to Robin's misbehavior, such as when [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) locked young [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) inside Pettifer's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), +2 more_

- Friend of — assisting him with hauling dulse and admiring him  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)</sub>
